content.title: Euphoria season 3 episode 2 release date: when will it come out on HBO Max?
content.text: Will HBO Max *ahem* Rue the day that it didn't make season 3 earlier? (Image credit: Patrick Wymore/HBO) Euphoria season 3 has finally made its debut — and, while it wasn't received well by critics, that didn't stop the likely millions of people from tuning in to its first episode.If you were one of them, you're probably wondering when the next chapter of Euphoria will be released. Well, wonder no more, because I came bearing gifts in the form of its launch date and time. Don't delay, then — find out when season 3's second entry will be out where you live.What is the launch time for Euphoria season 3 episode 2?Euphoria's next installment will air on Sunday, April 19 in North and South America, and Monday April 20 everywhere else.Article continues below Latest Videos From TechRadarExplAIned- Apple Intelligence Vs Galaxy AI0 seconds of 1 minute, 27 secondsVolume 0%In the US, new episodes of this season are confirmed to drop weekly at 9pm ET / 6pm PT. Based on those times, we can work out when it'll be available to stream in other nations, too, so read on to learn more:US — Sunday, April 19 at 9pm ET / 6pm PTCanada — Sunday, April 19 at 9pm ET / 6pm PTUK — Monday, April 20 at 1am BSTIndia — Monday, April 20 at 6:30am BSTSingapore — Monday, April 20 at 9am BSTAustralia — Monday, April 20 at 11am BSTNew Zealand — Monday, April 20 at 1pm BSTWhere can I watch Euphoria season 3?Sydney Sweeney's Cassie is still part of the multi-award-winning drama's cast (Image credit: HBO)In the US, new chapters of Euphoria's third season will air on cable network HBO and HBO Max, aka one of the world's best streaming services. It'll also land on the latter in countries where that platform has launched, such as the UK and Australia.For those who don't have access to HBO Max because a) it hasn't launched where you live or b) because you haven't signed up yet, don't worry. Euphoria season 3 is set to come out on other streaming services, so read on to see which one you need to tune into:US — HBO and HBO MaxCanada — CraveUK — HBO Max, Sky Atlantic, and Now TVIndia — JioCinemaSingapore — HBO GoAustralia — HBO MaxNew Zealand — NeonWhen will new episodes of Euphoria season 3 be released? Jacob Elordi's Nate is part of Euphoria season 3, too (Image credit: Patrick Wymore/HBO)Like most HBO TV Originals, new chapters of Euphoria season 3 will drop every Sunday in North and South America, and every Monday in other territories. That'll be the case until its eighth and final episode airs on May 31 / June 1.Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.Want to know when each entry will drop on a streaming platform near you?
